title: Multimode Phonon-Number Measurement and Single-shot Superparity Measurement using Dispersive Shifts in a Trapped Ion
summary: Dispersive shifts are a widely used tool for bosonic readout and control in circuit quantum electrodynamics, yet they remain relatively unexplored in trapped-ion motional systems. Here we introduce a unified framework for multimode phonon-number measurement and nondestructive single-shot superparity measurement, i.e., phonon-number measurement modulo 2^k, using dispersive shifts in the far-detuned multimode Jaynes-Cummings interaction of a trapped ion system. We implement a Ramsey sequence that realizes a multimode spin-dependent rotation (SDR) together with a selective decoupling scheme…
